commands.status: Read-only policy/tool/current-owned-wrapper status. --require-ready requires the actual online-write tests, Android passthrough, persistent re-selection/CRC and standard Recovery evidence; source implementation does not set these proofs.
commands.probe: Read only active BOOT and current Android identity. Reject unknown headers, nested wrappers, malformed layout, slot changes and incompatible GKI. Emit bounded reconstruction metadata, never a whole stock BOOT copy.
commands.repack: Extract the active current-ROM GKI, embed the explicit same-product selector/BootShim/FD/APP and SPLITv1+RSTRv1. --execute re-reads source hash, slot, ROM and bootimage property independently, writes only exact active BOOT then fsyncs and verifies complete readback. No inactive-slot, REC, vbmeta or GPT write.
commands.restore: Verify the currently active wrapper belongs to the same current ROM and source identity. Reconstruct the original kernel/header/footer from embedded original bytes and metadata; verify exact original-image SHA before writing/readback. Refuse an OTA or changed slot; never restore a historical ROM image.
commands.request: Preview or, with --execute, update only one older/invalid owned NEXTv1 page using shared BootRequest CRC and generation validation, fsync and verify complete BOOT readback. The route persists until another explicit selection (including Android target 0); status never consumes it. No misc/PMIC write or automatic reboot.
commands.adopt: Read-only recognition of an already wrapped active BOOT with exactly matching selector/BootShim/FD/APP. Validate lossless stock reconstruction and normalized wrapper identity, recheck active-slot Android identity, then save installation state. Reject --execute; no BOOT write.

entry_policy: A valid owned persistent request selects Android, UEFI menu or the installed Stable Linux entry; ordinary boots reuse that selection until another explicit change. Standard Recovery takes priority and passes through to the current ROM GKI. The early selector does not yet provide a volume-key override of the saved Android route. Setup target 3 exists in the native format but is not exposed by the helper.
webui: Installed-core helper provides Android/UEFI radio selection and one save-and-reboot action, with Chinese and English text. It uses the official KernelSU WebUI exec bridge through bounded action.sh operations. Opening the page uses quick-status; Check boot requests a complete read-only native status. UEFI entries are returned by the backend: menu plus Linux only when the matching Stable Linux boot file and ESP/root pair exist. Arbitrary ESP entries are not selectable yet. The manager Action button without arguments prints a plain-language summary and never reboots.

reconstruction.storage: One original GKI, full original BOOT/GKI headers and nonzero tail blocks with offsets are retained in SPLITv1+RSTRv1; zeros are reconstructed and original complete BOOT SHA256 is checked. Online installation state binds current ROM, independent bootimage property, actual footer fingerprint, active BOOT node/rdev and the immutable wrapper hash with only its two NEXT pages normalized. Request changes intentionally need not match the wrapper AVB data hash.

fresh_partition_install.new_layout_installation: Not provided by this module. No userdata resize, GPT or filesystem write.
fresh_partition_install.existing_linux: A Linux request requires an existing sunuefi_esp + sunuefi_root pair and their installed boot files.

package_readiness: Installed-core helper 0.2.0 packages matching adopt-exported payloads and tools for an already installed shared BOOT. Its installation is read-only and has been installed and activated in SukiSU. The independent first-install package retains --require-ready and its same-payload native/device proof requirements; incomplete proof flags remain false, and a candidate ZIP does not waive those requirements.
root_preservation: Dynamic repack retains the current raw ARM64 GKI bytes, including compatible KernelSU code, and leaves init_boot/vendor_boot/REC/vbmeta untouched. Unsupported current-BOOT layout or AVB metadata is refused; this is not a replacement CI kernel.
qualification_scope: Top-level device proof flags belong to the separately gated first-install package. Installed-core helper use does not set or replace those proofs.

installed_core_helper.installation: Read-only adopt of a matching existing shared BOOT; not a first UEFI installation.
installed_core_helper.manager_action: Plain-language read-only summary, no JSON dump or restart.
installed_core_helper.quick_status: Read owned request pages and read-only check of the actual EFI/Piano/stable/boot.img entry; does not hash the whole BOOT.
installed_core_helper.check_boot: Complete read-only native status; does not silently create installation state.
installed_core_helper.switch: Guarded persistent request write followed by ordinary reboot. Supported helper targets: android, uefi and installed Stable Linux.
installed_core_helper.reinstall_existing_wrapper: Read-only adopt of the matching wrapper; no nested repack.
installed_core_helper.reinstall_after_ota: Probe and repack supported current active-slot stock BOOT using current-ROM GKI and the same packaged core; restore saved preference. No automatic OTA hook or inactive-slot write.
installed_core_helper.uninstall: Remove helper only. Existing BOOT and persistent route remain unchanged.
